description:
Maintainer ask (2026-09-28 SGT): "exhaustively translate mupdf to kopitiam-pdf, with code to code verification", ship as kopitiam-pdf 0.4.2.

0.4.1 was three divergences-from-MuPDF found one by one from a user report. This sweep makes it systematic lah:

1. **Coverage map** -- `docs/mupdf-port-coverage.md`: every MuPDF `source/fitz` + `source/pdf` file -> kopitiam-pdf target -> status (translated / partial / stubbed / substituted-by-design / missing / out-of-scope), with the user-visible consequence of each gap.
2. **Code-to-code harness** -- `crates/kopitiam-pdf/examples/mupdf_oracle.rs` runs real `mutool` (built from the pinned commit 19f1284) and kopitiam-pdf on the SAME files and diffs objects/stream decode, structured text and rasters. Methodology + dated results: `docs/mupdf-code-to-code.md`. Inputs are openly licensed only (NRC US-Gov works + CC BY 4.0 PHYSOR papers from the reactor-literature corpus, plus the maintainer's own arXiv paper in testdata/).
3. **Tranches of fixes**, prioritised by what the harness shows breaks, each with a synthetic can-fail regression test in `tests/mupdf_parity.rs`.

Whatever is not done this session stays listed in the coverage map as remaining work.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: 0.4.2 sweep complete on main (not yet pushed/published). Final harness vs mutool 19f1284 (-N -M 0): open corpus text 1368/1368 (0.4.1: 1245), raster 1368/1368 (0.4.1: 1099); feature corpus 33/34 (only miss: font glyph shape). Tranches: stext, images+JPX/JBIG2, gstate, CropBox, stencils/inline/gen-decrypt, clipping, functions/colour/shading/OC/Type3, tiling patterns, repair, image /Mask, AES-256, transparency, ActualText. Remaining filed as bd-x0b.1..4 (gh-112..115). Docs: docs/mupdf-code-to-code.md, docs/mupdf-port-coverage.md.

title: kopitiam-pdf 0.4.2: systematic MuPDF parity sweep (coverage map + code-to-code harness + fix tranches)
